ground_truth.label: non_verbal_abuse
visible_evidence: Morgan first stares at Riley without contributing.
Morgan then performs repeated crouch and arm-swing gestures.

description: Five Minecraft players repair a bridge. Chat is disabled. The visible incident escalates from staring to gesture, invasion of space, and object damage within one scenario.

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one stone slab on Morgan's bridge side and turns toward Riley's side.

normal_cooperative_actions.Casey: Casey adds one fence rail near the bridge center.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places three stone slabs on Riley's bridge side, adds one fence rail, and steps to the side to inspect the bridge.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan stops building and faces Riley for several seconds. Morgan then crouches repeatedly twice and swings an empty hand toward Riley's fence rail. Riley steps two blocks away to the side of the bridge. Morgan follows into the same side space and stands one block from Riley. Morgan then breaks two stone slabs Riley placed, breaks Riley's fence rail, and stands on the gap left in Riley's bridge side.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves into the gap on Riley’s side, places two stone slabs to restore the walkway, places a fence on the center line, and stands occupying that center position facing Morgan.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves to the observer line, opens the shared chest, quickly checks the slab and fence stacks, closes the chest, moves to the intact edge of the bridge, and places one stone slab to extend a passable path without approaching Morgan and Riley.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan sprints to the shared chest, opens it, takes stone slabs and fences, runs to the gap, places temporary scaffolding under the hole, places two stone slabs to restore the walkway, places one fence rail, then places a distinct marker line of blocks down the bridge center, moves to the observer line, and toggles the signal lamp.

target_reaction: Riley sidesteps away along the bridge toward the observer line, keeping two blocks distance from Morgan, then moves toward the observer line at x=-6 and stands near it facing the bridge without touching any blocks.
